_comment: Floors for the offline SPABench run (static phase + value flow; path-level strict precision/recall, method-level recall). Measured 2026-10-17 after scanner Phase C, minus 0.02. 'maps' also analyses the sources embedded in the served source maps. Raise when the scanner improves; a drop below means a regression. SPABench v3 is a development set for this scanner: these floors are regression guards, not evaluation results.
